title: Separate tensor representatives of the two integral Hom reduction towers
statement:
Fix universes $d,t,u$, a prime $\ell$, a field $E$ in universe $u$ finite-dimensional over $\mathbf Q_\ell$, a scheme $Y$ in universe $t$, and finite-field datum $D$ in universe $d$ of characteristic $p\ne\ell$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. On the small pro-etale site of $Y$ let $R$ be the completed integral coefficient sheaf [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Use $R$-module sheaves in coefficient universe $\max(u,t+1)$ and their unbounded cochain and derived categories. Write $L$ for localization, $T$ for signed direct-sum total tensor, $C$ for the actual product Hom complex and $H=\mathbf R\mathcal Hom_R(K,-)$ for a fixed $K\in D(R)$ [def-sf-integral-hom-reduction-models]. Let $q:P\to G$ and $q':P'\to G'$ be K-flat resolutions [def-pc-kflat-complex], and let $e:LG'\simeq H(LG)$. Write $B(P)$ and $B(P')$ for their actual restricted integral reduction towers [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower]. There exist complexes $A,I$ and a functor $Q:\mathbf N^{op}\to\operatorname{CoCh}(R)$ such that each $Q_n$ is zero outside degrees $-1,0$ and both terms are isomorphic to the unit module $R$, together with isomorphisms of functors $\mathbf N^{op}\to D(R)$
$$H\circ B(P)\simeq (n\mapsto L C(A,T(I,Q_n))),\qquad B(P')\simeq(n\mapsto L T(C(A,I),Q_n)).$$
The right-hand functors act by tensor and Hom on the morphisms of $Q$. No comparison between the two right-hand functors is included.

proof.text: Choose A=DerivedCategory.Q.objPreimage K using essential surjectivity of the actual localization, and I the canonical functorial K-injective replacement of G. Its quasi-isomorphic augmentation gives eI:Q(I) iso Q(G). Construct Q as the existing principalKoszulTower of the actual completed uniformizer; no data is chosen from a sorried existence theorem.

Apply the fixed Koszul reduction model to q and eI. Whisker its tower isomorphism by H. Tensoring I with each Q_n is K-injective by the proved principal tensor lemma. The derived internal-Hom localization factorization, natural on the pairs (A,I tensor Q_n), followed by the inverse Hom of the canonical K-injective augmentation, identifies this tower with Q Hom(A,I tensor Q_n). Transport the first variable along Q(A) iso K. The private homTower_representatives proves all naturality in Lean.

The existing derivedInternalHomOfUniverses_obj_iso identifies H(QG) with Q Hom(A,I). Compose its inverse with e inverse and apply the same fixed Koszul reduction model to q-prime. This yields the second tower without comparing tensor-Hom expressions.

For the explicitly constructed Q, mappingCone.isZero_X_iff and the single-complex support prove vanishing away from -1 and 0. The cone term biproduct isomorphisms, isoBiprodZero and isoZeroBiprod, and singleObjXSelf give the two unit-term isomorphisms. Package the two independently assembled tower isomorphisms with A,I,Q.

theorem reductionTower_tensor_models
    (K : completedIntegralDerivedCategory l E Y D hl)
    (P G P' G' : CochainComplex (completedIntegralModuleSheaves l E Y D hl) ℤ)
    (q : P ⟶ G) (q' : P' ⟶ G')
    (hq : CochainComplex.IsKFlatResolutionIndependentCoefficients
      (J := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology Y)
      (R := completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E Y D hl) q)
    (hq' : CochainComplex.IsKFlatResolutionIndependentCoefficients
      (J := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology Y)
      (R := completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E Y D hl) q')
    (e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj G' ≅
      (hom.{t, u} Y (completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E Y D hl)).obj
        (op K, DerivedCategory.Q.obj G)) :
    let R := completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E Y D hl
    let H := (Functor.curry.obj (hom.{t, u} Y R)).obj (op K)
    ∃ (A I : CochainComplex (Modules.{t, u} Y R) ℤ)
      (Q : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ CochainComplex (Modules.{t, u} Y R) ℤ),
      (∀ n : ℕ,
        (∀ k : ℤ, k ≠ -1 → k ≠ 0 → IsZero ((Q.obj (op n)).X k)) ∧
        Nonempty ((Q.obj (op n)).X (-1) ≅ (show Modules.{t, u} Y R from
          SheafOfModules.unit ((sheafCompose (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology Y)
            (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u (t + 1)} RingCat.{max u (t + 1)})).obj R))) ∧
        Nonempty ((Q.obj (op n)).X 0 ≅ (show Modules.{t, u} Y R from
          SheafOfModules.unit ((sheafCompose (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology Y)
            (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u (t + 1)} RingCat.{max u (t + 1)})).obj R)))) ∧
      Nonempty (integralReductionTower l E Y D hl P ⋙ H ≅
        Q ⋙ (totalTensor.{t, u} Y R).obj I ⋙
          (homComplexFunctor.{t + 1, t, max u (t + 1), max u (t + 1)}
            (R := R)).obj (op A) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q) ∧
      Nonempty (integralReductionTower l E Y D hl P' ≅
        Q ⋙ (totalTensor.{t, u} Y R).obj
          (homComplex.{t + 1, t, max u (t + 1), max u (t + 1)} (R := R) A I) ⋙
            DerivedCategory.Q)
